reasons: Cited §8.2 text supports the compliant claim: renewals are successive twelve-month periods (no multi-year auto-renewal), Customer may opt out on thirty days' written notice (≤30-day preferred window), and Vendor must send a renewal reminder sixty days in advance, with the deadline tolled if the reminder is missed.
Cited §8.3 satisfies the price-predictability element of the preferred position: uplift capped at the lesser of US CPI and three percent, ninety days' notice, and no increase on prepaid periods.
Deterministic check confirms notice window = 30 days, within the preferred ≤30-day threshold; no walk-away trigger (no >90-day window, no multi-year renewal) is present.
Consistent with a compliant status, no redline or counterparty comment is proposed, which is appropriate — this is retained as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue.
